metadata.title: WRF namelist compatibility rules for editor
metadata.notes: Expanded curated-core compatibility coverage, fixed isftcflx parsing, and added explicit allowed-off cumulus/shallow-cumulus states.

rules.sourceExcerpt: bl_pbl_physics=1 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=1
bl_pbl_physics=2 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=2
bl_pbl_physics=4 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=4
bl_pbl_physics=5 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=1,2,5
bl_pbl_physics=6 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=5
bl_pbl_physics=7 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=1,7
bl_pbl_physics=8 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=1,2
bl_pbl_physics=9 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=1,2
bl_pbl_physics=10 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=10
bl_pbl_physics=12 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=1
bl_pbl_physics=16 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=1,5,91

rules.requirementsRaw: sf_sfclay_physics must be 7 | bl_pbl_physics must be 7
rules.sourceExcerpt: sf_surface_physics=7 Pleim-Xiu; use with Pleim-Xiu surface layer and ACM2 PBL

rules.requirementsRaw: ra_lw_physics must be one of 1, 3, 4 | ra_sw_physics must be one of 1, 3, 4
rules.sourceExcerpt: sf_surface_physics=8 SSiB; only works with ra_lw/sw_physics=1,3,4
sf_urban_physics ... use with Noah LSM only
sf_urban_physics=2 only works with bl_pbl_physics=1,2,8
sf_urban_physics=3 only works with bl_pbl_physics=1,2,8

rules.requirementsRaw: sf_urban_physics must be 1 | use_wudapt_lcz must be off / 0 0, False | wrfinput_extra requires 3 additional urban input variables

requirements.raw: wrfinput_extra requires 3 additional urban input variables

rules.sourceExcerpt: slucm_distributed_drag does not work with LCZ; only works with urban_physics=1; need additional input variables in wrfinput

rules.requirementsRaw: wrfinput_extra requires anthropogenic heat input variables

requirements.raw: wrfinput_extra requires anthropogenic heat input variables

rules.sourceExcerpt: distributed_ahe_opt requires additional input to wrfinput

rules.requirementsRaw: bl_pbl_physics must be 1 | geogrid_extra requires extra topographic wind inputs

requirements.raw: geogrid_extra requires extra topographic wind inputs

rules.sourceExcerpt: topo_wind requires extra input from geogrid; only works with bl_pbl_physics=1
seaice_threshold only works with sf_surface_physics=1,2,3,4,8

rules.requirementsRaw: sf_sfclay_physics must be one of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 91 | seaice_threshold must be 0
rules.sourceExcerpt: fractional_seaice=1 only works with sf_sfclay_physics=1,2,3,4,5,7,91; must also set seaice_threshold=0
sf_surf_irr_scheme=1 only works with sf_surface_physics=2

rules.requirementsRaw: opt_soil must be 3 | geogrid_tbl requires GEOGRID.TBL.ARW.noahmp
rules.sourceExcerpt: opt_pedo only works when opt_soil=3; geogrid must have been run with GEOGRID.TBL.ARW.noahmp
opt_irr geogrid must have been run with GEOGRID.TBL.ARW.noahmp

rules.requirementsRaw: opt_irr must be > 0 1, 2, 3 | geogrid_tbl requires GEOGRID.TBL.ARW.noahmp
rules.sourceExcerpt: opt_irrm only works when opt_irr>0; geogrid must have been run with GEOGRID.TBL.ARW.noahmp

rules.requirementsRaw: opt_run only confirmed with 3 | geogrid_tbl requires GEOGRID.TBL.ARW.noahmp
rules.sourceExcerpt: opt_tdrn only confirmed to work with opt_run=3; geogrid must have been run with GEOGRID.TBL.ARW.noahmp
cu_physics=7 only works with bl_pbl_physics=2,9
cu_physics=14 Scale-aware SAS; use with shcu_physics=4
kfeta_trigger only works with cu_physics=1
ishallow=1 only works with cu_physics=3 or 5
shcu_physics=5 only works with bl_pbl_physics=2,5,6
cugd_avedx=3 only works with cu_physics=5
kf_edrates=1 only works with cu_physics=1,11,99
convtrans_avglen_m only works with cu_physics=3,5,93
cu_diag=1 ... when using cu_physics=3,5,93

rules.requirementsRaw: cu_physics only works with 1, 3, 5, 10, 11, 93, 99 | cu_diag required if cu_physics in 3,5,93 1
rules.sourceExcerpt: cu_rad_feedback only works with cu_physics=1,3,5,10,11,93,99; if using cu_physics=3,5,93 must set cu_diag=1
maxiens only works with cu_physics=3,5,93
maxens only works with cu_physics=3,5,93
maxens2 only works with cu_physics=3,5,93
maxens3 only works with cu_physics=3,5,93
ensdim only works with cu_physics=3,5,93
lightning_option must set do_radar_ref=1

rules.requirementsRaw: dx intended range 10 km < dx < 50 km | cu_physics intended use parameterized-convection scales

requirements.raw: dx intended range 10 km < dx < 50 km

rules.sourceExcerpt: lightning_option=11 intended for use at 10<dx<50km with cumulus parameterization

rules.requirementsRaw: iccg_prescribed_num must also set set | iccg_prescribed_den must also set set
rules.sourceExcerpt: iccg_method=1 must also set iccg_prescribed_num and iccg_prescribed_den
nwp_diagnostics=1 and do_radar_ref=1
ra_sw_eclipse=1 only works with ra_sw_physics 1,2,4,5
icloud only works with ra_sw/lw_physics=1 or 4

rules.requirementsRaw: ra_lw_physics only works with 3, 4, 14, 24 | ra_sw_physics only works with 3, 4, 14, 24
rules.sourceExcerpt: bucket_J only works with CAM and RRTMG radiation options (ra_lw/sw_physics = 3,4,14,24)
aer_opt=3 only works with Thompson aerosol-aware microphysics (option 28)

rules.requirementsRaw: diff_opt must be 2 | bl_pbl_physics must be 0 | sf_sfclay_physics must be one of 1, 5, 91
rules.sourceExcerpt: km_opt=5 only works with diff_opt=2, bl_pbl_physics=0, sf_sfclay_physics=1,5,91

rules.requirementsRaw: diff_opt should be used with 2 | km_opt should be used with 2, 3
rules.sourceExcerpt: sfs_opt=1 should be used with diff_opt=2 and km_opt=2 or 3

rules.requirementsRaw: diff_opt should be used with 2 | km_opt should be used with 2
rules.sourceExcerpt: sfs_opt=2 should be used with diff_opt=2 and km_opt=2

rules.requirementsRaw: isfflx template uses 1 | sf_sfclay_physics template uses any non-zero | sf_surface_physics template uses any non-zero | diff_opt template uses 2 | km_opt template uses 2, 3
rules.sourceExcerpt: LES PBL settings: bl_pbl_physics=0, isfflx=1, sf_sfclay_physics any except 0, sf_surface_physics any except 0, diff_opt=2, km_opt=2 or 3
isftcflx=1,2 must be used with sf_sfclay_physics=1

rules.requirementsRaw: auxinput4_inname requires wrflowinp_d<domain> | auxinput4_interval requires set | io_form_auxinput4 requires set
rules.sourceExcerpt: sst_update=1 requires auxinput4_inname, auxinput4_interval, io_form_auxinput4

rules.requirementsRaw: auxinput11_interval must also set set | auxinput11_end_h must also set set
rules.sourceExcerpt: obs_nudge_opt=1 must also set auxinput11_interval and auxinput11_end_h
multi_bdy_files=.true. with bdy_inname='wrfbdy_d<domain>_<date>'

rules.requirementsRaw: domain_role must be set for nest

requirements.raw: domain role should indicate a nested domain

rules.sourceExcerpt: nested=.true. must be set for nests
specified=.true. for outer domain in real-data cases

rules.requirementsRaw: metgrid_NUM_LAND_CAT must match must match | MODIS default typical value 21 | USGS typical value 24
rules.sourceExcerpt: num_land_cat must match metgrid NUM_LAND_CAT; 21 for MODIS, 24 for USGS

rules.requirementsRaw: compile_env requires TERRAIN_AND_LANDUSE=1 | geog_data_res requires usgs_30s+default or matching hi-res | rsmas_data_path requires set

requirements.raw: geog_data_res requires usgs_30s+default or matching hi-res

rules.sourceExcerpt: input_from_hires requires TERRAIN_AND_LANDUSE=1, hi-res geog_data_res, and rsmas_data_path

rules.requirementsRaw: use_theta_m must be 0 | hybrid_opt must be 0
rules.sourceExcerpt: To use pre-V4 wrfinput/wrfbdy, set use_theta_m=0, hybrid_opt=0, force_use_old_data=.true.

rules.requirementsRaw: cu_physics=0 means no cumulus parameterization and is allowed
rules.sourceExcerpt: cu_physics=0 means no cumulus parameterization; turning cumulus off for a domain is allowed
rules.notes: Explicitly marks off-state as allowed so the UI does not imply conflict.

rules.requirementsRaw: shcu_physics=0 means no shallow cumulus and is allowed
rules.sourceExcerpt: shcu_physics is an independent shallow cumulus option; 0 means off and is allowed
thBinSize is a CuP PDF bin-size option and only works with cu_physics=10
minDeepFreq is a CuP frequency threshold option and only works with cu_physics=10
minShallowFreq is a CuP frequency threshold option and only works with cu_physics=10

bl_pbl_physics.summary: bl_pbl_physics=0 ⇒ isfflx=1; diff_opt=2; km_opt=2; km_opt=3 || bl_pbl_physics=1 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=1 || bl_pbl_physics=10 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=10 || bl_pbl_physics=12 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=1 || bl_pbl_physics=16 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=1; sf_sfclay_physics=5; sf_sfclay_physics=91 || bl_pbl_physics=2 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=2 || bl_pbl_physics=4 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=4 || bl_pbl_physics=5 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=1; sf_sfclay_physics=2; sf_sfclay_physics=5 || bl_pbl_physics=6 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=5 || bl_pbl_physics=7 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=1; sf_sfclay_physics=7 ...

sf_surface_physics.summary: sf_surface_physics=7 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=7; bl_pbl_physics=7 || sf_surface_physics=8 ⇒ ra_lw_physics=1; ra_lw_physics=3; ra_lw_physics=4; ra_sw_physics=1; ra_sw_physics=3; ra_sw_physics=4

sf_urban_physics.summary: sf_urban_physics=1 ⇒ sf_surface_physics=2 || sf_urban_physics=2 ⇒ sf_surface_physics=2; bl_pbl_physics=1; bl_pbl_physics=2; bl_pbl_physics=8 || sf_urban_physics=3 ⇒ sf_surface_physics=2; bl_pbl_physics=1; bl_pbl_physics=2; bl_pbl_physics=8

fractional_seaice.summary: fractional_seaice=1 ⇒ sf_sfclay_physics=1; sf_sfclay_physics=2; sf_sfclay_physics=3; sf_sfclay_physics=4; sf_sfclay_physics=5; sf_sfclay_physics=7; sf_sfclay_physics=91; seaice_threshold=0

opt_irrm.summary: opt_irrm=1 ⇒ opt_irr=1; opt_irr=2; opt_irr=3 || opt_irrm=2 ⇒ opt_irr=1; opt_irr=2; opt_irr=3 || opt_irrm=3 ⇒ opt_irr=1; opt_irr=2; opt_irr=3

cu_physics.summary: cu_physics=0 ⇒ no cumulus parameterization (allowed) || cu_physics=7 ⇒ bl_pbl_physics=2 or 9 || cu_physics=14 ⇒ shcu_physics=4

shcu_physics.summary: shcu_physics=0 ⇒ no shallow cumulus (allowed) || shcu_physics=5 ⇒ bl_pbl_physics=2, 5, or 6

kfeta_trigger.summary: kfeta_trigger=1 ⇒ cu_physics=1 || kfeta_trigger=2 ⇒ cu_physics=1 || kfeta_trigger=3 ⇒ cu_physics=1

cu_rad_feedback.summary: cu_rad_feedback=True ⇒ cu_physics=1; cu_physics=3; cu_physics=5; cu_physics=10; cu_physics=11; cu_physics=93; cu_physics=99; cu_diag=1

do_radar_ref.summary: do_radar_ref=1 ⇒ mp_physics=2; mp_physics=4; mp_physics=6; mp_physics=7; mp_physics=8; mp_physics=10; mp_physics=14; mp_physics=16; mp_physics=17; mp_physics=18; mp_physics=19; mp_physics=21; mp_physics=24; mp_physics=26; mp_physics=28

use_mp_re.summary: use_mp_re=1 ⇒ mp_physics=3; mp_physics=4; mp_physics=6; mp_physics=7; mp_physics=8; mp_physics=10; mp_physics=14; mp_physics=16; mp_physics=18; mp_physics=24; mp_physics=26; mp_physics=28; mp_physics=50; mp_physics=51; mp_physics=52; mp_physics=53; mp_physics=55

bucket_j.summary: Requires CAM or RRTMG radiation families: ra_lw_physics and ra_sw_physics in 3, 4, 14, or 24.

km_opt.summary: km_opt=5 ⇒ diff_opt=2; bl_pbl_physics=0; sf_sfclay_physics=1; sf_sfclay_physics=5; sf_sfclay_physics=91

sfs_opt.summary: sfs_opt=1 ⇒ diff_opt=2; km_opt=2; km_opt=3 || sfs_opt=2 ⇒ diff_opt=2; km_opt=2

auxinput4_interval.summary: Used with sst_update=1; requires companion auxinput4 lower-boundary settings.

io_form_auxinput4.summary: Used with sst_update=1; typically set to 2 for netCDF lower-boundary files.

auxinput11_interval.summary: Observation nudging companion setting; should be set when obs_nudge_opt=1.

auxinput11_end_h.summary: Observation nudging companion setting; should be set when obs_nudge_opt=1.

nested.summary: nested=.true. is for nested domains only.

specified.summary: specified=.true. is for the outer real-data domain only.
